verdict.rationale: Porkbun's documented API explicitly supports full CRUD on DNS records across many record types (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA, TLSA, SSHFP, ALIAS, HTTPS, SVCB) plus DNSSEC DS records, directly enabling programmatic automation and ACME-style challenge record management (e.g., TXT record create/delete). This is corroborated across multiple docs pages and a live probe confirming the API documentation is reachable. Missing for 10: no independent third-party hands-on report specifically confirming DNS CRUD workflow (e.g., ACME TXT record automation) in practice beyond vendor docs.
